queries: WITH p AS (SELECT bp.player_id, pl.bats, AVG(bp."double") AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player pl ON pl.player_id = bp.player_id WHERE pl.bats IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(pl.bats) <> '' GROUP BY bp.player_id, pl.bats), i AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles * 1.0 / AVG(avg_doubles) OVER () AS idx FROM p), d AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS hand_avg_idx FROM i) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx AS index_value, idx - hand_avg_idx AS index_minus_hand_avg FROM d ORDER BY (idx - hand_avg_idx) IS NULL, idx - hand_avg_idx DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_player AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.bats) <> '' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), idx AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / AVG(avg_doubles) OVER () AS idx FROM per_player), final AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx AS index_value, idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS diff_from_hand_avg FROM idx) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, index_value, diff_from_hand_avg FROM final ORDER BY diff_from_hand_avg DESC NULLS LAST, player_id LIMIT 10

WITH per_player AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.bats) <> '' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), idx AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM per_player) AS idx FROM per_player), final AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS idx_minus_hand_avg FROM idx) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, idx_minus_hand_avg FROM final ORDER BY (idx_minus_hand_avg IS NULL), idx_minus_hand_avg DESC LIMIT 10

responses.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT bp.player_id, pl.bats, AVG(bp."double") AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player pl ON pl.player_id = bp.player_id WHERE pl.bats IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(pl.bats) <> '' GROUP BY bp.player_id, pl.bats), i AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles * 1.0 / AVG(avg_doubles) OVER () AS idx FROM p), d AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS hand_avg_idx FROM i) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx AS index_value, idx - hand_avg_idx AS index_minus_hand_avg FROM d ORDER BY (idx - hand_avg_idx) IS NULL, idx - hand_avg_idx DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Empty batting hand means NULL, an empty string, or whitespace only. Those players are excluded before any average is computed.

The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-player average doubles. Players whose doubles values are all NULL have a NULL average. They are ignored in both the overall average and the hand average, and they sort last.
The hand average is the mean of players' indexes within each batting hand. Ties in the difference are broken arbitrarily.

responses.sql: WITH per_player AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.bats) <> '' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), idx AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / AVG(avg_doubles) OVER () AS idx FROM per_player), final AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx AS index_value, idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS diff_from_hand_avg FROM idx) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, index_value, diff_from_hand_avg FROM final ORDER BY diff_from_hand_avg DESC NULLS LAST, player_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average and the per-hand average index are taken over per-player averages, with each player counted once. Players whose doubles are all NULL have a NULL average and are left out of both averages, but they stay in the result set and sort last.
An empty batting hand means an empty or whitespace-only string. These are excluded along with NULL, both from the overall average and from the output.
Ties in the difference are broken by player_id, which the request does not specify.

responses.sql: WITH per_player AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.bats) <> '' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), idx AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM per_player) AS idx FROM per_player), final AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS idx_minus_hand_avg FROM idx) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, idx_minus_hand_avg FROM final ORDER BY (idx_minus_hand_avg IS NULL), idx_minus_hand_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-player averages (one value per player), not the mean over all postseason records. Players whose doubles values are all NULL have a NULL average and are skipped by both the overall and hand averages, but can still appear in the output with a NULL difference, sorted last.
An empty batting hand means an empty string or whitespace only. Such players and NULL-hand players are excluded before any averaging.
Players with no postseason batting records are not included, because the join is an inner join.
